q1_issues.issue: The prohibition is encoded as a strength-0 bundle containing (Obligated sk_temper_1) — exactly the negated-(Obligated e) form the instruction set forbids for a prohibition, which requires (Permitted e) at strength 0.0 — so the atom means "this steel is not required to be tempered" rather than "this steel must not be tempered".
The weakening carried by "should" (strength 0.7 for a positive deontic) is dropped entirely: the bundle is a flat (STV 0.0 0.99) with nothing distinguishing "should not" from "must not".

q2_gaps: Weak prohibition "should not / ought not": the prohibition rule lists only must not / may not / shall not / forbidden-to and maps them to (Permitted e) at strength 0.0, and the 0.7 weakening is defined only for the positive "should" obligation — the instruction set gives no strength recipe for a weakened denial of permission.
notes: Everything else is right: the demonstrative "this steel" is a typed witness projecting outside the strength-0 denial, the agentless passive omits the Agent, and tempering is a treatment that changes the object so Patient is correct.
